_comment: Which analysis a spec's latest analysis was: short or full.
`aide-run-spec` reads it off the `- **Analysis:**` bullet in the Tracking info of the spec's
2-analysis.md (record/short-analysis-check.sh) and the dashboard reads the same bullet
(parsePhaseOutcome) to draw the short-analysis line on the spec's row.
`line` is the whole bullet written in Tracking info; null means the bullet is not written at all.
`analysis` is what both sides read: only a lower-case `short` is short and only a lower-case
`full` is full; no bullet, or any other value, is read as full (every spec analysed before the
bullet existed) and the dashboard keeps no value for it.
